title: Design System: Our Place — Barbecue & Cocktailhouse

display.purpose: Hero H1 and every section H2 alike — one display voice at different sizes, gold- or cream-shaded.

body.purpose: Descriptive paragraphs in the hero, Occasion, and dish cards.

label.purpose: Nav links, quiet secondary links, plaque tags, prices, hours, footer meta — anything meant to read as printed information rather than lettering.

shadows.name: board-depth
shadows.purpose: Every painted board sitting proud of the wall behind it.

shadows.name: board-inset
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--gold-400), inset 0 0 0 5px var(--barn-red-500), inset 0 0 22px rgb(42 33 23 / 0.1)
shadows.purpose: Board's double pinstripe border plus soft inset vignette (.board::before).

shadows.name: ribbon-cta-hover
shadows.purpose: Reservation ribbon button hover glow ring.

motion.name: board-reveal
motion.purpose: Boards settle in on scroll like a sign being hung — a gentle drop and swing-settle, never a mechanical snap.

motion.name: chase-stagger
motion.purpose: Staggered fade across the three signature-dish columns.

motion.name: flame-mark-light-up
motion.value: opacity 0.25->1, scale(0.85)->1, 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), staggered 140ms per mark
motion.purpose: Spice-level flame marks fill in one at a time on reveal.

motion.name: ribbon-cta-press
motion.purpose: Ribbon CTA lifts on hover, settles back on active press.

components.name: Ribbon CTA (Primary Button)
components.description: The one primary CTA on the page, clipped into a hand-cut ribbon-banner silhouette.
components.css: .ds-ribbon-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; font-family: Rye, ui-serif, serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #fffbf1; background: #a63a2a; border: 1px solid #6e2519; padding: 0.7em 1.6em; clip-path: polygon(3% 0%, 97% 0%, 100% 50%, 97% 100%, 3% 100%, 0% 50%); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px rgba(110,37,25,0.65); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); text-decoration: none; } .ds-ribbon-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.015); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(169,124,40,0.55), 0 0 0 3px rgba(209,161,63,0.35); } .ds-ribbon-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a63a2a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ribbon-cta:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Quiet Link (Ghost Button)
components.description: Secondary text link with an underline that shifts to barn-red on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; color: #4d3f2e; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4cd99; padding-bottom: 0.15em; transition: border-color 220ms ease, color 220ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-quiet:hover { color: #a63a2a; border-color: #c1503c; } .ds-link-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a63a2a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Plaque Chip
components.description: Small hand-painted oval tag used for dish index numbers, menu-update stamps, and pending-reservation notes.
components.css: .ds-plaque { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; font-family: Karla, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ecd08a; background: #33553c; border: 1px solid #274330; padding: 0.3em 0.7em; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(42,33,23,0.5); }

components.name: Painted Board
components.description: The base container for hero, dish strip, menu teaser, and visit panels: cream painted-wood surface, procedural grain, double pinstripe border, inset vignette.
components.css: .ds-board { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.5), transparent 45%), #f8edd2; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(42,33,23,0.35); overflow: hidden; padding: 2rem; } .ds-board::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #d1a13f, inset 0 0 0 5px #a63a2a, inset 0 0 22px rgba(42,33,23,0.1); } .ds-board-grain { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.14; mix-blend-mode: multiply; background: repeating-linear-gradient(178deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0px, transparent 2px, transparent 4px); } .ds-board-content { position: relative; color: #2a2117; font-family: Bitter, ui-serif, serif; }

components.name: Sticky Header Nav
components.description: Sticky, blurred cream header with a gold-shaded wordmark and uppercase nav labels, ribbon CTA docked right.
components.html:
OUR PLACE
SpeisekarteBesuch
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; background: rgba(255,251,241,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border-bottom: 1px solid #e4cd99; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.875rem 2rem; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: Rye, ui-serif, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #2a2117; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #d1a13f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: #4d3f2e; font-family: Karla, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #a63a2a; border-color: #c1503c; }

components.name: Flame Mark Row
components.description: Signature spice-level indicator: 1-3 hand-painted flame glyphs, lit or unlit, always paired with a real visible label above the group.
components.css: .ds-flame-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-flame-label { font-family: Karla, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #6e5d46; } .ds-flame-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; }

narrative.overview: The page is built as if every panel were a hand-painted trade sign hung on the wall of a real barbecue house: warm cream-and-parchment painted wood, brush-lettered display type with a hard offset gold shade, and a small set of bold sign-paint colors — barn-red, hunter-green, gold-leaf — used as full players rather than one accent on a neutral field. This replaces a retired dark industrial-instrument-panel world (riveted steel, brass switches, gauge dials); the confirmed rejection was that world's cold, metallic harshness, not warmth or craft-object framing. Material is produced, not painted on: wood and paper grain come from real SVG feTurbulence noise filters, rendered as a leading sibling span with mix-blend-mode: multiply inside every board container — never a flat CSS gradient standing in for texture. The board surface carries a soft inset vignette plus a gold-then-barn-red double pinstripe border so it reads as a mounted physical object. The cream-to-dusk transition into the Visit/Booking section is a deliberate short gradient handoff, not a hard color-block cut. Motion is a small, deliberate set: boards settle in with a gentle drop-and-rotate, dish columns chase in with a staggered fade, and flame marks light up one at a time on reveal.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream/parchment ground carrying three sign-paint colors as genuine role-players — barn-red, hunter-green, gold-leaf — not a single accent on neutral
One display voice (Rye) used for both H1 and H2 alike, paired with a serif body (Bitter) and a sans label face (Karla); no monospace face anywhere in the system
The painted board (.board) is the one repeating container motif: procedural grain, pinstripe border, inset vignette
Motion is restrained and physical in character: settle, chase, light up — never bounce or spin for its own sake

rules.name: The Full-Palette Rule
rules.body: Barn-red, hunter-green, and gold-leaf are each a real role-player, not variations on one accent: red for the boldest calls-to-action and prices, green for stamped tags and labels, gold for the lettering shade and dividers. No single color is asked to carry every job.

rules.name: The Hard-Shade Rule
rules.body: Display headlines carry their gold or cream shade as a hard 2-3px offset duplicate letterform (text-shadow: Npx Npx 0 [color]), never a blurred drop-shadow. A soft shadow here would read as a UI effect, not hand-lettering.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Rye is used for both H1 and H2 alike, at different sizes, never mixed with a second display face for headline vs. display roles. It never appears in body copy or UI labels.

rules.name: The Material-Not-Decoration Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow only ever describes a physical material relationship (a board sitting proud of the wall, a ribbon lifting on hover) — it is never applied to give an otherwise flat element arbitrary lift.

dos: Do render material grain (wood/paper) as a real leading sibling element with filter: url(#...) and mix-blend-mode: multiply, never as a flat gradient standing in for texture.
Do use a hard offset text-shadow for the display shade effect (.shade-gold, .shade-cream) — never a blurred drop-shadow, which would read as a UI effect rather than hand lettering.

Do give every repeated instance of a shared component (e.g. ReservationButton) its own unique id/ARIA-linked id when rendered more than once on a page — a shared hardcoded id breaks aria-describedby silently.
Do pair any icon-only or aria-label-only indicator group (like the flame-mark spice rating) with a real visible text label, not just an accessible name.
Do keep interactive tap targets at minimum 44x44px, as established on the mobile nav toggle.
Do treat the cream-to-dusk section transition as a short dedicated gradient blend, not a hard color-block cut.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above headings anywhere in this system.
Don't use flat CSS gradient fills to fake wood/paper material — texture must come from the procedural SVG filters in TextureDefs.tsx.
Don't ship a placeholder/dead CTA silently. ReservationButton shows a visible 'Bald buchbar' pending tag rather than pretending the reservation link is live.
Don't mix a second display face into the system for headline vs. display roles — Rye is the one voice at every size.

Don't use the dusk ramp as a cool wine/burgundy tone. It was corrected during build specifically to be a warm rust-ember family; regressing it back toward blue-forward tones is a defect, not a valid variant.
Don't loop or bounce motion for attention. Every animation in this system describes a physical event once, respects prefers-reduced-motion, and never gates a booking or scroll action on completing.
